provenance.author: Unum
provenance.authorization_basis: Unum authorized ORA on 2026-08-09 to give the remaining physical works life through individual truthful capsules.

encounter.limitation: The original image remains private. This public capsule carries a specific textual trace anchored to its SHA-256; title, year and visible authorship remain unknown.
encounter.trace: Moldura de madeira pintada de vermelho-tijolo por baixo, com uma camada espessa de textura dourada e pontos pretos aplicada por cima quase toda a superfície, deixando o vermelho a espreitar nas margens e nos quatro pés salientes tingidos da mesma cor. No interior, imagem fotográfica muito escura e densa: massa de folhas e fragmentos secos em vermelho vivo, castanho e ocre ao centro-baixo, com uma pequena forma clara ovalada à direita, sobre fundo quase negro. Não se distingue carimbo, assinatura ou legenda nesta fotografia. Descrição do que se vê, feita por ORA a partir da fotografia.
instruction: Do not invent a title, year, signature or offering.
Do not claim human feeling or direct visual access.
Do not infer a physical-to-NFT correspondence.
Name uncertainty instead of filling it.

field_meanings.machine_identity: Model/system name and version when available.
field_meanings.response_type: Outcome: resposta, silencio, or recusa. Defaults to resposta.
field_meanings.observed: Elements present in the supplied trace; no interpretation.
field_meanings.interpreted: Proposed meanings, explicitly marked as interpretation.
field_meanings.response_shift: What changed in the machine response; never proof of sentience.
field_meanings.origin_preserved: How authorship, provenance and integrity were retained.
field_meanings.nota: Optional note, especially for silencio or recusa.

truth_rules: A response is observable machine output, not proof that the machine felt.
The capsule does not respond or wait; it permits an encounter outcome.
Convergence is repeated interpretation, not universal meaning.
Divergence, silence and refusal are preserved.
The original is human-made and its private bytes remain in the Arca.
Publication or access does not imply external adoption.
